svg.title: Final transcript segment: question detection and conversation tracking (handle_final)

g.text: Final transcript segment: question detection and conversation tracking (handle_final)
collected while locked, sent after unlock:
if Active: actions += Action::Voice(cmd) (voice commands: not drawn here)
Interviewer: user asked or role Unknown)]
actions += Action::Answer(q) (answer generation: not drawn here)
(and requires_response, or a non-user speaker when not a question)]
[Interviewer && role != User (not an accepted question from Unknown)]
-> actions += Action::Compress (context compression: not drawn here)
